summary: Full end-to-end testing of the new Injury Graph (LTI/MTI) feature — 10/10 backend pytest cases pass and all frontend UX flows verified through Playwright. Auth, /data shape, auto-aggregation (LTI via ceased_work='Yes' and MTI via 'No'), single-cell override, year override, override-year deletion and invalid type rejection are all working. Frontend renders page with correct title, default end-year 2026, sidebar highlight, three totals cards, two Bar charts (LTI/MTI) with 12 month labels and 3 yearly datasets, edit modal save flow producing chart bars in correct months, totals card updating to 7, Reset-to-Auto reverting to 0, and end-year change re-rendering with 2023/2024/2025.
critical_code_review_comments: Both routes hardcode default MONGO_URL/DB_NAME values (os.environ.get('MONGO_URL', 'mongodb://localhost:27017')). Per env-var guideline, defaults should be omitted so misconfig fails fast.

An unrelated 'Mixed Content' error blocked GET /api/settings/ (http instead of https) — surfaced across the app but does not affect the Injury Graph feature. Worth fixing in the settings service caller globally.
Override-year endpoint loops 12 update_one calls — fine for a 12-row write but a bulk_write would be cleaner.
InjuryGraph.js uses Chart.js `useMemo([data])` which is OK, but exhaustive-deps warning could appear; non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Tests create + delete their own injury_register records (TESTLTI). Override-year LTI 2026 is set and reset by tests; final test_delete_year_override_reverts leaves no override behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_injury_graph.py covers all 6 endpoints + auth + edge cases. Use admin/admin123 to login. Charts are rendered via react-chartjs-2; the canvases live inside #injury-lti-chart / #injury-mti-chart wrappers. Note: a pre-existing seed injury record exists giving 2024 MTI=1 — that's expected register data, not an issue.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in the Injury Graph feature.
